build_oxford_iiit_pet_dataset: build the Oxford-IIIT pet dataset builder to download and generate train/test splits with images and segmentation masks
create_builder_info: create dataset info with image, label, species, file_name, and segmentation_mask features for the Oxford-IIIT pet dataset
test_split_generators: test the split generator setup that downloads images and annotations archives and creates train and test splits
review_generate_examples: review the example generator that reads image list files and yields records with image paths, labels, species, and segmentation mask paths
summarize_builder_class: summarize the Builder class that extends GeneratorBasedBuilder to produce the Oxford-IIIT pet dataset with 37 breed labels and cat/dog species
